title: Software Engineer
description:
Details: Kavyos Consulting Inc. East Brunswick, NJ and multiple client locations nationwide .

Duties: Work at client sites to:

Design and develop AML (Anti Money Laundering) Solutions using NICE Actimize solutions AIS 10 Analytics Intelligence Server and ActOne Designer.

Develop and test Actimize ecosystem using AIS and RCM tools.

Design and develop Business to Business Compliance applications on Actimize Tool using configurations and customizations of Java based applications and integrate such applications with Actimize-based systems.

Enhance existing solutions to match client requirements by configuring and customizing software using SQL and XML/ XSL.

Limited domestic travel (5-10%), telecommute and/or occasional relocation to multiple client locations nationwide.

Requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Computer science, Computer/Electronics Engineering/Instrumentation Engineering or related technical field, or foreign equivalent, and two years of experience in the job offered.

Send resume to: Kavyos Consulting Inc. at 197 Route 18 Suite 210 N East Brunswick NJ 08816 or email resume to raj.agarwala@kavyos.com

Salary: $135,000.00/Year and PTO, medical, dental, vision and retirement benefits.
